raw_text:
1. This Act may be cited as the Civil Law (Amendment)
Act, No. 36 of 1981.
Short
title.

2. Section 5 of the Civil Law Ordinance is hereby
amended by the substitution for the words "five per
centum", of the words "twelve per centum".
Amendment
of section.
5 of
Chapter
79.
